# 仙鹤的学习小窝

> 坚持学习，无限进步

This is the llms.txt file for 仙鹤的学习小窝. It provides a machine-readable directory of published articles and core pages for Large Language Models.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://fairycrane.website/): Main blog entrance and latest post stream.
- [About](https://fairycrane.website/about/): Author profile, technical stack, and background.
- [Archive](https://fairycrane.website/archive/): Chronological index of all published writings.
